source.citation: Nakhostin-Ansari A, Naghshtabrizi N, Naghdi S, et al. Normative values of functional reach test, single-leg stance test, and timed UP and GO with and without dual-task in healthy Iranian adults: a cross-sectional study. Ann Med Surg (Lond) 2022;80:104053. doi:10.1016/j.amsu.2022.104053
source.population: 240 healthy Iranian adults, 40 per age band, supervised testing
source.protocol: Barefoot, hands on hips, standing on the test leg unassisted, maximum 60 seconds
